prompts.title: Niche test
prompts.summary: Checks a niche before you design for it: who buys, what they already wear and the inside jokes.
prompts.prompt: I'm thinking of a print-on-demand line for [niche]. Tell me: who buys for this group (themselves or gifts), what they already wear or use, five phrases or inside jokes they'd recognize that aren't trademarked, what they'd find cringe, and three places they gather online. End with a yes, maybe or no and why.
prompts.use: Run it before you design anything. Check every phrase for trademarks yourself before you print it.

prompts.title: Mockup image prompts
prompts.summary: Image prompts that put your design on a real-looking person in a place your buyer goes.
prompts.prompt: Write five image prompts for mockups of a [product] with this design: [describe it]. The buyer is [niche]. Each prompt: the person, the place, the light, the camera angle and what they're doing. No celebrities, no brand logos, no real places' signage.
prompts.use: Use them in any image model. Label any AI image as a mockup on your page.

prompts.title: Margin check
prompts.summary: What a sale leaves after the printer's base price, shipping, fees and ads.
prompts.prompt: My printer charges [$] base for a [product], shipping is [$], my store fee is [%], payment fee is [%]. I sell it for [$]. Show what one sale leaves, then what's left if I spend [$] on ads per sale. Table, then one sentence.
prompts.use: Run it per product before you run any ad.
